spans.s:
1. मिक्ष् or मिमिक्ष् (prob. Desid. from a lost √ मिश्, contained in मिश्र and मिश्ल; but referred by others to √ मिह्, q.v.; only pr. मि॑मिक्षति pf. मिमिक्ष॑तुः, ˚षे॑, ˚षिरे, and Impv. मिमिक्ष्व॑; cf. सम्-√ मिक्ष्),
to mix (Ā. intrans.), mingle with (instr.), prepare (an oblation of Soma &c.), RV.; VS.; Br. :
Caus. मेक्षयति, to stir up, mix, mingle, ŚBr.
